P1.1.text: Bowhead Specialty | Specialty Insurance & Underwriting Experts

P1.2.text: Bowhead Specialty provides tailored specialty insurance solutions. Expertise in professional, casualty, & healthcare liability coverage.

P1.3.text: Tailored underwriting for standard and complex risks. We offer Directors & Officers, Management Liability, Cyber, and Errors & Omissions coverage on admitted and non-admitted paper, serving public, private, and not-for-profit organizations, including financial institutions.

P1.4.text: Broad casualty coverage with the expertise to handle complex, high-hazard risks. Our core industries include construction, hospitality, public entity, manufacturing, real estate, and environmental.

P1.5.text: Medical Malpractice, Management Liability, and Errors & Omissions coverage specifically designed for healthcare organizations, including hospitals, medical facilities, senior care providers, and managed care organizations.

P1.6.text: Surface promises are easy. Depth is earned. We deliver what others don’t.

P1.7.text: We created Bowhead Specialty with a clear-eyed view of the market, seeing opportunity where others pulled back.

P1.8.text: Bowhead blends deep expertise with advanced technology and first-class service to enable the underwriting of risks with varying levels of complexity. Our capabilities span a range of product lines that support our brokers’ needs.

P1.9.text: Amid declining capacity, mispriced risk, and retreating carriers, we saw the need for a better approach.

P1.10.text: A specialty lines company led by experienced underwriters, focused on quality risk selection, and grounded in a culture that values character as much as capability.

P1.11.text: We have a firm belief that underwriting excellence starts with people, so we built a team of respected industry veterans, united by a commitment to excellence and superior service.

P1.12.text: Bowhead can help you navigate your specialty insurance needs with clarity and confidence.

P2.1.text: About Us | Bowhead Specialty | Custom Specialty Insurance

P2.2.text: Learn about Bowhead Specialty, our mission, team, and custom insurance coverage solutions. We offer tailored primary and excess coverage.

P2.3.text: At Bowhead Specialty, we aim to to make the complex manageable and the experience consistent for every client, partner, and employee.

P2.4.text: We do that by building with purpose: underwriting with precision, communicating with clarity, and operating with consistency from start to finish.

P2.5.text: We’re committed to a culture where collaboration transcends titles and departments. Every perspective is valued and ideas are strengthened through seamless partnerships across teams. By challenging one another with respect and celebrating shared wins, we create an environment of consistent growth and innovation.

P2.6.text: Brokers and insureds know exactly what to expect when they work with Bowhead Specialty: consistency, confidence, and care in the products and services we deliver.

P2.7.text: Bowhead Specialty provides tailored primary and excess insurance coverage solutions across multiple core divisions: Professional Liability, Healthcare Liability, and Casualty. Visit our appetite page for details of coverages offered.

P2.8.text: We serve a wide range of clients, from well-established public companies to growing private businesses and nonprofits. Our underwriters work to provide custom coverage for complex risks across multiple industries.

P2.9.text: We don’t believe in one-size-fits-all policies. Our underwriting-first model is backed by deep sector expertise, advanced analytics, and technology. Our core craft solutions are custom-built to meet the specific needs, risk profiles, and goals of our clients.

P2.10.text: Bowhead Specialty has expertise across a wide array of industries, including but not limited to construction, manufacturing, financial services, healthcare, hospitality, distribution, and technology.

P2.11.text: Yes. We offer both primary and excess coverage across multiple lines, including General Liability, Professional Liability, and Healthcare Liability, giving clients the flexibility to build layered programs that align with their risk management strategies.

P2.12.text: We offer both admitted and non-admitted coverage options, depending on the line of business and jurisdiction. This allows us to provide flexible solutions tailored to regulatory and client-specific needs.

P2.13.text: Bowhead Specialty offers solutions in all 50 US states. Our business is primarily written on an E&S (Excess and Surplus) basis. We have offices in New York

P1.3.text: Kingstone Companies, Inc. (“Kingstone”) is a northeast regional property and casualty insurance holding company whose principal operating subsidiary is Kingstone Insurance Company (“KICO”). KICO is a New York domiciled carrier writing business through retail and wholesale agents and brokers. KICO is actively writing personal lines and commercial auto insurance in New York, and was the 11th largest writer of homeowners insurance in the State of New York. Kingstone is also licensed in New Jersey, Rhode Island, Massachusetts, Connecticut, Pennsylvania, New Hampshire, and Maine.
